docs.author: Dr. Noor Haddad
sentences: Patient is a 44-year-old man with low back pain for about two months.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Symptoms persist after more than two months of physical therapy and daily naproxen.
Reports numbness and tingling along the outer left calf.
Sleeps about six hours a night.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1016 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document at least six weeks of conservative treatment before imaging. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
